name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
description: Incline bench press targeting the upper chest for clavicular head development.
setup: Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Lie back, dumbbells at chest height, palms forward.
execution: Press dumbbells up and slightly inward, lower to chest stretch.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
common_mistakes: Incline too steep hitting mostly delts

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
description: Decline press emphasizing lower chest for complete pectoral development.
setup: Set bench to decline or use hip bridge position on floor.
execution: Press dumbbells up from lower chest level, squeeze at top, lower with control.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on press
progression: Heavier weight or pause at top

name: Incline Dumbbell Flye
description: Incline flye isolating the upper chest through a wide stretch and squeeze.
setup: Set bench to 30 degrees, lie back with dumbbells over chest, elbows soft.
execution: Open arms wide in a stretch arc, squeeze back together over upper chest.
progression: Pause at stretch or heavier weight
safety_notes: Stop if front of shoulder hurts
